name: Does my homeowner's insurance cover sewage backup cleanup?

mainEntity.name: Does my homeowner's insurance cover sewage backup cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowner's insurance policies offer coverage for sewage backups, especially if the damage is sudden and accidental. However, coverage can vary greatly. Some policies require a specific 'sewer and drain backup' endorsement for coverage. It's crucial to review your policy or contact your insurance provider to understand your specific coverage details, deductibles, and any limitations. A professional restoration company can often help document the damage and work with your insurer during the claims process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance often covers sudden and accidental sewage backups, but specific 'sewer and drain backup' endorsements may be required. Check your policy or contact your insurer for details.
